title: DocLayNet
refusal_reason: admitted, no file bound. acquire tried twice: open_access=blocked (challenge-page detection fired; the challenged host is not named in the tool's own output), annas=bad-file (a download was returned and quarantined as not a valid PDF), scihub=blocked both times; browser is last-resort only and was not run.

title: Meuschke et al. 2023 PDF-extraction-tools benchmark
refusal_reason: none — open_access acquire ok (Springer DOI, arXiv-mirrored), then GROBID+Docling extract+ingest both ran; coverage 0.9994, 0 pages below the 0.8 floor.

title: Bast and Korzen 2017 PDF text-extraction benchmark
refusal_reason: admitted, no file bound. acquire not attempted: IEEE-paywalled 2017 proceedings paper with no arXiv mirror found; deprioritized to stay inside the time budget once the DocLayNet/BEIR failures showed the paywalled-DOI pattern (Meuschke's Springer DOI was checked instead and DID succeed via open access, so this skip is a time-budget call, not evidence Bast & Korzen would also fail).

title: BEIR
refusal_reason: admitted, no file bound. acquire tried once: open_access=binding-failed (a PDF was fetched but did not pass the title/identity check that binds it to the admitted work), annas=not-in-archive, scihub=blocked.
